visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man stands centrally in front of a patterned beige wall, wearing a light grey sweatshirt with a purple 'Lakers' logo and black pants. He has his hands clasped in a traditional greeting gesture, speaking with an animated facial expression. He stands on a purple platform. Large pink and white text overlays appear at the bottom. (2) The visual cuts to a slightly wider shot where another man in a white hoodie joins the first man on the right. Both are smiling and performing the same hand-clasping greeting. Pink text continues to cycle on the screen. (3) A new man wearing a grey long-sleeved shirt and a black baseball cap enters the foreground, speaking directly to the camera with high energy. The previous two men are visible in the background. The lighting is bright and even across the indoor studio setting. (4) The camera shows a full group shot of seven men standing in a line on the purple platform. They are all laughing, cheering, and shouting in unison, wearing various casual sweaters and hoodies. Large yellow and orange text overlays appear at the bottom of the frame. (5) The screen transitions to a solid black background with static white and red text centered in the frame, representing the closing title card.

It uses a cumulative narrative structure where more people are added to the frame as different greetings and well-wishes are spoken in both Mandarin and Hokkien. The high-energy audio and rapid text overlays are designed to convey joy, prosperity, and a sense of team unity from the '料理123' brand creators.
